rpcProviders.description: Add an API key to route supported networks through your own provider. Priority: per-network RPC, then your providers, then Vela built-in, then the chain index.

These services power your wallet.
You can deploy your own instances for full self-custody.
endpoints.chainDataHint: Provides network info, token data, and chain logos
endpoints.passkeyHint: Stores passkey public keys for cross-device sign-in
endpoints.fiatHint: USD-based exchange rates that drive the currency list — swap for wider coverage.
endpoints.resetBody: All four services go back to Vela's own addresses. The addresses you entered here are forgotten.

addNetwork.description: Search by network name, token symbol, or Chain ID.
addNetwork.unableToVerify: Unable to verify — RPC request failed
addNetwork.incompatibleHint: Some contracts Vela needs aren't on this network yet. Chain Setup shows which ones and who can deploy them.
addNetwork.noP256Hint: This network can't check passkey signatures: it has no P-256 verifier (EIP-7951 / RIP-7212 at 0x100), and only the network's own team can add one. Vela wallets can't work here. Don't send money to your Vela address on this network. It would be stuck.
addNetwork.singleKeyOnly:
A wallet with more than one passkey cannot be created on this network: Safe's passkey signer factory is not deployed here.
A wallet with one passkey works normally.

backup.title: Copy this wallet's record to Ethereum
backup.couldNotCheck: Couldn't check. Tap to try again.
backup.cannotCopy: This older wallet can't be copied
backup.explain: Your wallet's record on Gnosis is public: its address and name, and for each key its name, public key, credential ID and authenticator model. A device with one of your passkeys finds this wallet through it. This puts a copy on Ethereum too. It's one Ethereum transaction: you confirm it with a passkey and pay its network fee in a coin you hold on Ethereum. The copy can't move money or bring back a lost passkey.

keys.title: Keys
keys.subtitle: Any one of these passkeys can sign for this wallet, on every network.
keys.fromDevice: Couldn't reach the registry. Showing what this device remembers.
